title: Zack Whyte, the Savoy and his first record
summary: He joined Zack Whyte, came to New York to play the Savoy, and sang on his first record with Luis Russell and Higginbotham without being credited.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And after that, I joined Zack Whyte.
Were these bands mostly working around the Midwest?

So I met Zach Whyte, and joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack, and played the Savoy. And that's when I made my first record that they released. But I never got any...what do they call it...? No mentions on it. But I sang it. It was with Luis Russell, and it was a piece of...oh, I'm trying to... Nesbitt!
John Nesbitt was playing with Zack Whyte at the time. You know, he was with the Cotton-Pickers, with McKinney's.
Anyway, we made this record, and... I don't know why I didn't get any... I guess it's because I sang so bad probably. Yeah, (?)talking about that(?) reminds me.
Yeah, I've heard it. It's nice. Maybe they didn't put your name on it... Usually they put the vocalist's name on it.

No, they didn't put my name in nowhere. Higgenbotham was in the band, and he played the trombone solo -- and I did the singing. But it was a good chance to be on the thing, you know... All I wanted to do... I wanted to play, really.
Oh yes. I sang pretty regularly with the band, you know...
